**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Customer:

- **No MFN language in either direction.** Independent searches for "most favored nation", "no less favorable", "favored/favorable", comparable/similarly-situated customer pricing, lowest or best price, matching competing third-party offers, and rights of first refusal all returned nothing.
- **Article 8 (Fees) is purely Fee-Schedule driven** — costs and charges are fixed by Schedule 8.1 (p0128), with Customer *receiving* discounts on certain Services (p0153). Nothing requires us to extend to M&I any terms given to any third party.
- **The two "then-current rate" mechanics run on M&I's own prices, not on third-party comparisons:** the Event-of-Default reversion to M&I's then-current standard published prices (p0151) and Termination Assistance charged at M&I's then-current rates (p0192). Those are pricing-uplift points, not MFN burdens, and are outside this rule.
- **Article 3, Article 10 (p0185) and Article 22 contain no matching or best-terms covenant.**

Because Customer carries no MFN obligation benefiting M&I, the preferred position is satisfied and no redline was proposed. An MFN in our favour remains an optional commercial ask, not a playbook requirement under this rule.
